completed_steps: Inventoried the pinned engine's commands, config, transports, permission semantics, persistence, model resolution, and platform restrictions into 71 capability rows (28 verified, 42 routed-pending, 1 unavailable, 0 blocked gaps)
Wrote the stdlib-only P01 Runtime API spike with descendant-socket ownership verification, bounded SSE parsing, and process-tree cleanup; 13 tests pass

Ran a real tool-enabled Full Access turn: wrote hello.txt, ran node verify.mjs (PASS), observed 64 SSE events, effective deepseek/deepseek-flash, history, session export/resume 200, and a confirmed interrupt with no stray sleep process

Measured concurrent owned runtimes: the second listener was owned by the first runtime and the first token authenticated the second port; recorded single-owner serialization instead of fabricating isolation
Ran the paired cost pilot under the $2 ceiling: 3 tasks, all accepted, total-token deltas within +0.77%/-0.33%/-0.26%, adapter cost $0.012559; direct cost recorded unknown
Proved zero inference for startup, discovery, 2s idle, history reads, and empty-thread SSE reconnect
Proved packaged native execution with no Node on PATH and CLT Finder Service feasibility (compile, NSServices plist, ad-hoc sign, LaunchServices registration)
Wrote P01-feasibility.md with G0/G1/G2 verdicts, ADR-P01, and carried-forward gaps
notes: G2-01: 42 rows are discovered/routed but remain unqualified until their named contract tests pass (P03 owns the adapter).
G1-01: direct `codewhale exec` agent mode omits usage/cost in its summary and records coverage_recorded=false; exact cost parity stays provisional.
G0-01: independent parallel runtimes are unsupported; serialize owned runtimes.
P02 input: the listener is a grandchild of the npm wrapper; supervision must track the process tree.

completed_steps: Scaffolded Electron 45.3.0 + React 19 + TypeScript + Vite with pinned dependencies, lockfile, npm scripts, and native/packaging locations
Implemented the security boundary: sandboxed/context-isolated renderer, narrow contextBridge, strict Zod IPC, trusted-sender checks, CSP connect-src none, denied navigation/window.open/permissions
Defined Mona contracts with branded IDs, strict unknown-field policy, separate upstream wire types, and 8 labeled fixtures
Built the local window with app version, placeholder navigation, native menu/Services, hiddenInset titlebar, close-versus-quit policy
Added per-user Application Support/Cache/Logs paths and GUI-launch tool discovery with Homebrew fallback
Added local CI (format/lint/typecheck/test/build/renderer secret scan) and a real Electron smoke test with 17 observed checks
Verified clean npm ci, 44 passing tests, 0 renderer secret findings, 226,270-byte renderer baseline, ~408 MB working set
Wrote ADR-001, ADR-002, and P02-foundation evidence
notes: P02-01: tools/monabuild and tools/p01-spike are excluded from product ESLint/Prettier scope; they are pre-product utilities.
P02-02: visual/accessibility automation is deferred to P06/P26; the shell is semantic but not certified.
P02-03: Electron embeds Node 24.22.2; runtime code must not assume the host Node 26 APIs.
P02-04: fsevents reports an unapproved optional install script; not needed for build/test/smoke.
P02-05: no Developer ID signing yet (P22 prerequisite).

completed_steps: Implemented the EngineAdapter: discover, owned runtime, create/open thread, submit, reconcile, subscribe, interrupt, history, usage, effective profile, capability invocation, shutdown
Enforced exact pinned version/commit and required capabilities; typed unsupported reasons for optional operations
Persisted submission intent before POST; lost responses become outcome_unknown and reconcile only through the read-only operation lookup, never a blind retry
Implemented bounded SSE parsing with streaming UTF-8 decode, per-thread seq dedupe, deterministic replay projection, durable/progress/diagnostic/terminal separation, and unknown-event preservation
Rejected wrong-thread turn responses, history, interrupt receipts, and stream events without mutating another thread
Verified effective provider/model/permission posture from the turn, with strict fail-closed profile checks
Added 70 passing tests including recorded fixtures, response-loss, reconnect equality, malformed/schema-drift frames, and UTF-8 boundaries; local CI green
Passed the real pinned-runtime smoke: 10/10 checks, completed turn, strict effective route, same-turn operation lookup, clean shutdown
notes: P03-01: approvals, clarifications, steer, artifacts, workspace search/restore, terminal, and fleet are not adapter operations yet.
P03-02: process supervision is minimal by design; P04 owns liveness, descendants, crash restart, and quit/stop semantics.
P03-03: P05 replaces the JSON submission store without changing persist-before-send ordering.
Interrupt on a completed turn returns 409; the adapter reports 'no active turn' rather than a confirmed stop. Active-turn interrupt was proven in P01 and is covered by the fixture test.
Usage reports costComplete=false whenever unpriced turns are in range; that is preserved, not coerced to zero.

completed_steps: Implemented the native arm64 Swift supervisor: private process group, fd-3 owner-liveness channel carrying the token, 250 ms descendant sampling, escaped/reparented descendant cleanup by (pid,start), PID-reuse refusal, bounded TERM then KILL for verified survivors, and control-socket status/stop receipts

Implemented the Node supervisor layer: process identity, atomic 0600 token-free ownership records, one runtime per user store, workspace serialization, read-only external attach, stale-record reconciliation, and bounded process-only restart

Hardened runtime startup: workspace and executable validation with SHA-256, port bind preflight, child parent/start/executable verification, authenticated loopback runtime info, pinned compatibility, listener-in-tree verification, and typed actionable failures

Implemented desktop lifecycle: single instance with second-launch folder handoff, window close keeps work, renderer crash isolation, Dock reopen, sleep as reconnecting, resume health probe, and bounded restart with no automatic resubmission
Implemented distinct pause-after-task, interrupt-now, cancel-queued, and quit-and-stop transitions with uncertainty and no-rollback reporting
Verified: 119 tests pass, Electron lifecycle smoke 21/21, real pinned-engine smoke 17/17 through the supervisor, local CI and secret scan green
notes: P04-07: stop receipts carry verified; only the supervisor control socket can prove the tree is gone. Fallback stops report verified:false and are recorded failed for re-check.
P04-08: a restart requires a supervisor-emitted stopped receipt with no survivors; otherwise STOP_UNVERIFIED with no restart and no second owner.
P04-09: adapter layer refuses a start beside a live/orphaned record or a record whose pid cannot be proven; starts are serialized.
P04-10: npm test builds the supervisor first; the native suite fails rather than skips on the arm64 target host.

completed_steps: Selected and verified built-in node:sqlite (Electron 45 Node 24.22.2): DatabaseSync, WAL, foreign keys, and the online backup API work without a native module
Implemented schema v1 plus a v2 upgrade with checksummed migrations, per-row revisions, foreign keys, one BEGIN IMMEDIATE write path, and a single store writer
Implemented the maintenance barrier shared by reads and writes; backup, snapshot, and restore take it exclusively and quiesce active work
Implemented pre-migration snapshots with durable journals, snapshot restore on migration or validation failure, preserved failed databases, and refusal of newer or edited schemas
Implemented project identity by canonical path and (dev, ino): alias deduplication, path history, deliberate relocation, catalog removal without touching source, and nested-repo/worktree detection
Implemented tasks, dependencies, evidence, attempts, decisions, events/cursors, usage, capability snapshots, settings versions, drafts, submissions (SqliteSubmissionStore), and runtime bindings

Implemented digest-checked portable project export/import with revision conflicts, atomic import, bounded content-addressed artifacts, retention that protects blocked-task evidence, and disk-full refusal that cannot claim completion
Wired per-user Application Support storage into the Electron app; smoke reports an open, integrity-clean, 0600/0700 database

Verified: 37 new P05 tests (166 total), crash injection before/during/after a transaction, migration failure restore, backup/restore with quiesced writers, alias/worktree/relocation cases, and Electron smoke 21/21
notes: P05-01: product state is SQLite via node:sqlite; engine history remains authoritative and runtime bindings plus artifact bytes are machine-local, excluded from export.
P05-02: a second real macOS account was not created; path isolation, 0700/0600 modes, and the absence of a token column are verified here, and literal multi-user denial belongs to P24.
P05-03: network filesystem refusal uses /usr/bin/stat -f %T and is skipped when that tool is unavailable; the P24 host audit must confirm.
P05-04: artifact bytes are not portable; import reports missing digests rather than inventing files.

completed_steps: Defined Daybreak and Afterglow tokens in code and audited 23 foreground/background pairs per theme (16 text at 4.5:1, 7 UI at 3:1); moved coral off normal text and strengthened interactive borders after measurement

Built accessible primitives: button, icon button, field, text input, textarea, select, tabs with roving focus, focus-trapped dialog, keyboard menu, notification, callout, badge/status badge, card, inspector, empty state, skeleton, error state, segmented control, switch, keycap

Built six fixture-backed screens (home, studio, work board, cost lens, blocker, settings) with 40-event timeline, long paths and task names, unknown cost, disconnected, blocked, empty, and permission states
Implemented density controls, 120-180 ms bounded motion, reduced-motion support, Command-key screen switching, command palette shell, and a persistent labeled harness banner
Verified at 1280x800 and at real 200% Chromium zoom (640x400 CSS viewport) with zero horizontal page overflow in both themes; captured 15 Electron-rendered screenshots

Added axe semantic audits for every screen and state (zero serious/critical), keyboard interaction tests, a visible-focus Tab receipt, and a renderer source scan proving no fetch/XHR/WebSocket, remote fonts, scripts, styles, or images
Verified: 26 design tests, 192 total tests, Electron smoke 21/21, lint 0 errors
notes: P06-01: the renderer is explicitly a fixture harness; P07 replaces it with the real catalog, runtime status, and project state.

P06-02: axe runs without a layout engine under jsdom, so color contrast and clipping are measured separately from tokens and the Electron shot manifest; no automated scanner is claimed as certification.
P06-03: human aesthetic review and the VoiceOver walkthrough remain P24/P26 activities; this prompt does not claim they already occurred.
P06-04: focus uses an explicit :focus outline rather than relying solely on the :focus-visible heuristic, so the indicator is present under keyboard and programmatic focus.

completed_steps: Added WorkStudio: explicit start of the supervisor-owned runtime for the selected project, canonical-workspace verification, refusal of external runtimes, authenticated loopback adapter, and one mutating turn per workspace

Wired the composer with Plan/Work, drafts, real cost, observed route and permission, and explicit disabled reasons for unsupported attachments
